title: One-cent step: single, taxable $1,999,999.99 with 2 cents of qualified dividends

source.where: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.01 Table 3 (single) and 4.03 (the 20 percent gains rate), worked in exact fractions of a cent and rounded once

note: Taxable 201,609,997 + 2 - 1,610,000 = 199,999,999. Ordinary 199,999,997 taxed by the brackets and 2 cents at 20%: 69,595,724.29 exactly, so 69,595,724 when rounded once. Rounding each piece first gave 69,595,725.

title: One-cent step: single, taxable $2,000,000.00 with 2 cents of qualified dividends

source.where: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.01 Table 3 (single) and 4.03 (the 20 percent gains rate), worked in exact fractions of a cent and rounded once

note: Taxable 200,000,000. Ordinary 199,999,998 and 2 cents at 20%: 69,595,724.66 exactly, so 69,595,725 when rounded once. Rounding each piece first gave 69,595,724, a cent less than at $1,999,999.99.
